mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.price, CASE WHEN p.stock > 0 THEN 'IN_STOCK' ELSE 'OUT_OF_STOCK' END AS stock_status, p.sales, p.status FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND p.audit_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY p.sales DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, sales = sales + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{productId} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND status = 'ON_SALE' AND audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{productId}
